text:
Sara (Marketing): FYI — engineering confirmed the rollout plan for embeddings v2. We want the blog, social, and benchmark assets to land only after the canary passes. Can Eng/Docs confirm exact timing and final links? :eyes:

Jamal (Eng): Canary starts 2026-03-31T18:00Z. Plan: 2h @10% -> 1h ramp to 50% -> full at ~21:00Z if healthy. We can tweak +/-30m if marketing needs tighter alignment.

Leo (Docs): Docs PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/482 — changelog blurb and migration snippet are in the PR description. I'll lock the branch after copy edits.

Sara (Marketing): Great. Marketing needs a one-line changelog we can drop into the post and a final docs URL for the CTA. Short plain english preferred.

Leo (Docs): Use this changelog line:

"Changelog: Embeddings API v2 — up to 3x throughput for dense vectors, automatic prefix caching, and smaller quantized artifacts."

Jamal (Eng): Ops note for advanced users (include if you want an "under the hood" box):

"Ops note: v2 uses dynamic batching (default max_batch_size=256). To prioritize single-request latency, set max_batch_size=8 on the route."

Anya (Product): On inbound routing — will the trial/signup webhook include a release tag so Marketing can filter signups tied to the launch campaign?

Jamal (Eng): Yes. We'll add release_tag: "embeddings-v2" to the production webhook payload. Payload fields: company, email, plan, use_case, sample_qps, release_tag.

ops-bot: deploy-scheduler scheduled: docs.lock -> 2026-03-31T17:30Z, canary rollout -> 2026-03-31T18:00Z. Notifying #eng-oncall.

Sara (Marketing): Two asks from MKT ops:
- Exact final doc URL for the blog CTA
- Confirm embargo/unlock policy (when do we unqueue in CMS?)

Leo (Docs): Final doc URL after merge: https://docs.redwood.ai/reference/embeddings/v2 — I'll paste the exact anchor once merged. ETA for merge: 2026-03-31T17:20Z.

Jamal (Eng): Roll/rollback policy: proceed to public only if no perf regression >5% and no error-rate spike >0.5% across the canary window. If thresholds breach, auto-rollback to v1 and we'll post status here immediately.

Sara (Marketing): Please post short status updates in this thread at +30m and +90m into canary (just green/red + one-liner). Marketing will hold the publish until we see the +90m green.

Jamal (Eng): Will do. Tagging @Maria (oncall). I'll also push perf harness run right after canary completes.

Maria (Oncall): Oncall acked. I'll watch p50/p95/p99 and error rate. Will escalate within 5 minutes if any threshold hits.

Sara (Marketing): For the blog we'll include one benchmark PNG (throughput vs latency) and a small table showing unit-cost delta. Perf team — can you generate the canonical PNG from the production config and share here after the canary?

perf-bot: Perf run scheduled after canary completion. Estimated availability of PNG: ~30m after public rollout (or 21:30Z if rollout finishes on schedule).

Leo (Docs): Docs merged. Final URL: https://docs.redwood.ai/reference/embeddings/v2 — migration snippet and client example are live. Copy-editers: please skim the examples quickly.

Sara (Marketing): CMS plan: we'll queue the blog with an embargo to 20:15Z. If Jamal posts +90m green earlier and rollout completes, we'll un-embargo and publish immediately. If rollback occurs, we keep embargoed until resolved.

Jamal (Eng): That matches ops intent. I'll post the +30m and +90m checks here (format: STATUS: green/red — reason). Good luck :rocket:

Sara (Marketing): One last note — we'll tag the social posts with #EmbeddingsV2 and point to docs + benchmark. Please DM me if anything changes outside this thread.

Maria (Oncall): Will post alerts here if I escalate. Standing by.

Sara (Marketing): Thanks everyone. I'll update the release checklist and add the final doc + PNG links once both are in. :thumbsup:
